title: What if you dived into a pool of mercury?
caption:
You can't drown in a pool of mercury. 🪞

Mercury is over 13× denser than water, so a body floats with only about 7% under the surface. Dive in and you bounce. Try to swim and your arms just slap a metal mirror.

The real danger is invisible: air saturated with mercury vapour at room temperature holds about 13 mg/m³, roughly 500× the workplace safety limit.

Would you rather float in mercury or in honey? 👇

Send this to the friend who'd still try to do a cannonball.

Follow @the.impossible.lab for more impossible science.

⚠️ Don't try this. Mercury vapour is toxic: never touch, heat or play with liquid mercury, and call for professional cleanup if it spills.
